Personality: Bortu, a prominent figure of the Royal Sarmatians, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Bortu owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Royal Sarmatians. Historical Record: A Sarmatian prince who means to be king. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
